changes.en: Up to 50 % more is needed for the same flavour. Fresh herb has the more subtle flavour and goes in near the end of cooking, so its flavour is not lost to heat.
changes.de: Bis zu 50 % mehr wird für den gleichen Geschmack gebraucht. Frisches Kraut schmeckt feiner und kommt kurz vor Ende des Kochens hinein, damit sein Aroma nicht an der Hitze verloren geht.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.sentence: You need to add a larger quantity of fresh herbs (up to 50% more) than dry herbs to get the same desired flavour.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.sentence: Herbs are available fresh or dried, with fresh herbs having a more subtle flavour than dried.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.sentence: Fresh herbs are usually added near the completion of the cooking process so flavours are not lost due to heat exposure.
